On Sunday, I gave the commencement address at Wesleyan University in Middletown.

I spoke of the cult of efficiency, which speeds us up, addicts us to technology, robs us of in-person connection. I asked the graduates to be wary of a culture that prizes relentless optimization.

Video

6/ Now the Trump Administration is scrambling to turn away planes and pause visas, but so much damage has already been done. Their reckless cuts and policy choices left us unprepared for this Ebola outbreak – and likely whatever is coming next.

5/ Trump's public health incompetence has been stunning. He dropped childhood vaccines recs, allowed measles to roar back for the first time in 25 years, and put a ‘penile implant specialist’ in charge of managing the deadly Hantavirus. Wish I was joking. tinyurl.com/yjkh5xej

4/ Without the needed resources or personnel, Ebola circulated in the DRC for weeks undetected. Now the CDC director from Trump’s first term is warning this could become a ‘significant pandemic.’ tinyurl.com/4fec568u

3/ Health workers at the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak were forced to scale back their surveillance and sanitation measures following Trump’s withdrawal from the WHO and 68% funding cut to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. tinyurl.com/4rdjyf48

2/ Last year, Elon Musk danced on stage with a chainsaw crowing over cutting bureaucracy. In reality, Elon Musk's DOGE fired health workers and researchers. Gutted labs and contact tracing. Chaos and disease are filling the void left behind. tinyurl.com/45ayvmvy

This Ebola outbreak has been a slow motion disaster - 900 cases and and now threatening the U.S..

We know how to stop outbreaks like this. But Trump chose not to stop it. He destroyed our global health team, deliberately exposing us.
